verdict.comment: The mare ONE OF OUR OWN looks ready to strike after a couple of close-up efforts. She has most to fear from One More Dream.

comments.bayraat: 1-21 under rules and doesn't strike as the sort to win following an eight-month absence
comments.dandydinmont: Hasn't been beaten far in three starts this year but needs a strong pace to show his best
comments.happier: Below-par this year including when seventh at Thirsk on Saturday
comments.muscika: Prolific winner but hasn't won on turf since August 2023; on career-low mark
comments.onemoredream: Most of his winning has been done on AW (nine wins) but has won twice on turf recently
comments.oneofourown: Has finished close up on her last two starts and she should go close
comments.papacocktail: Yet to make the frame since returning from 16-month absence for current trainer
comments.rapidogirl: Fifth of eight on stable debut at Wolverhampton 13 days ago and should run well
comments.runningcool: Has struggled for his current yard since coming from Ireland where he won twice in 2023
comments.taygar: May have found ground too quick when eighth of 11 at Doncaster last month

races.raceComment: oneofourown is marginally preferred with a score of 57.5%. Won 1 of last 6 starts. Ground (Good To Firm) looks ideal with 4 wins from 19 starts in similar conditions. Could develop into tactical affair with no obvious pace-setter. Key attributes include optimal distance, though step up in class and unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.

verdict.comment: Jonny Concrete and 2024 winner Sacred Falls are respected but MAY BLOSSOM is on a fair mark and a stiff 6f suits her well.

comments.agirlnamedivy: Now 2lb lower than 6f win at Pontefract in August; bit to prove on subsequent form
comments.actofviolence: Impressive at Ripon (6f); weights pull with Jonny Concrete later; might need another run
comments.irisdancer: Latest win over C&D last July; well treated but struggled for a while; blinkers refitted
comments.jonnyconcrete: Progressive at 7f and 6f; up another 3lb for Musselburgh win; may improve further
comments.katsbob: Won first four starts for this yard but well held latest and now 6lb higher
comments.kingsmerchant: Three 6f handicap wins in 2024 but below best this year and now in first-time headgear
comments.mayblossom: Below best since Pontefract win (6f) in August but just 1lb higher; likely type
comments.mostardreams: Acts well here, a 7f winner and close second over C&D in 2024; good return for new yard
comments.sacredfalls: Last year's winner; won a shade cosily at Catterick latest; major contender
comments.truepromise: Four AW wins at 5f-7f; 0-5 on turf but fair third over 6f at Ripon recently; thereabouts

races.raceComment: sacredfalls is marginally preferred with a score of 64.0%, holding clear edges in more progressive over jonnyconcrete. Won 1 of last 6 starts. Ground (Good To Firm) looks ideal with 2 wins from 10 starts in similar conditions. Likely to be steadily run with pressure on the leader. Key attributes include excellent form and optimal distance and positive comments, though unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.

comments.caffuzafeen: Hopes are pinned on a wind op/drop in trip prompting something extra from him
comments.diamonddreamer: Better strike-rate on AW than turf; fair 4th 2 weeks ago but others perhaps better treated
comments.faustus: Two 5f wins last summer; on winning mark; should fare better having had a run last month
comments.lipsink: Absent since a poor run in December but can go well fresh; other pace to deal with
comments.maharajasexpress: Several excuses at Lingfield (5f, good to firm) 9 days ago; in good form on AW beforehand
comments.nogosdream: Not easy to win with but reliable, in-form and goes well at the track; contender
comments.thecoffeepod: Dangerous mark on his best form but he's looked temperamental in two runs this year

comments.coyy: Second run wasn't as promising as his debut (both 5f, good); now tried in a tongue-tie
comments.dappercharm: Runner-up in both starts (5.3f, good to firm) at Brighton; should go well once again
comments.eclipser: Half-sister to the very useful Pandora's Gift out of well-related 5f winner; check market
comments.eyesfront: 12,000gns half-brother to four winners; enough paper appeal to warrant a second look
comments.goreygold: Half-brother to 6f 2yo winner Corinthian Kid (RPR 75); fair standard to aim at on debut
comments.jackthetooth: 18,000gns half-brother to two winners; yard's 2yos yet to get going this season
comments.ladylauren: 14,000gns yearling; dam a 1m2f winner in France; yard not known for 2yo exploits
comments.parodadiva: Similar form in two 5f runs so far; marked improvement needed to take this
comments.risingempire: Promising 4th at Leicester three weeks ago; 6f will suit and he's open to lots of progress

comments.bluebolt: Never involved when 10-11 at Southwell but she's a likely improver on this step up to 1m
comments.chinkara: Sets the standard on her promising run at Ascot and yard was 42% with 3yos here last year
comments.electrifarhh: Beat a subsequent winner at Kempton in October and she's respected under penalty on return
comments.satavia: Siyouni filly who has a smart pedigree and needs a close look on debut
comments.starlitspice: Two promising runs and latest was at Haydock last month; not ruled out

races.raceComment: starlitspice is marginally preferred with a score of 23.9%. Going is a significant concern - yet to win on Good To Firm ground from 1 attempts. Could develop into tactical affair with no obvious pace-setter. Key attributes include improving, though step up in class and unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.

verdict.comment: This can go to CROWD QUAKE who improved for the new trip and surface when a C&D winner last time and is still on a modest mark.

comments.charlesmorin: Returns from fruitless hurdling spell but capable of good run if that hasn't left a mark
comments.crowdquake: Appreciated the switch to turf and new trip when C&D winner latest; up 6lb; can improve
comments.devizes: Multiple AW winner at 1m4f-2m but out of sorts over the winter; 0-6 on turf
comments.fightingpoet: Two Brighton wins (1m4f and 1m2f) in 2024; never sighted there on return; other days
comments.formaladdress: Promising handicap debut on AW (1m2f); not so good since; fitting tongue-tie could help
comments.glenesk: Two C&D wins before absence; it's proving a long road back for this yard; up against it
comments.offiahsboy: Fulfilled earlier AW promise when giving best only late on at Leicester (1m2f); same mark
comments.popnoodle: Much lower in weights than 1m2f turf handicap runs in 2024 but continues vulnerable
comments.regalglory: Sole win at 7f; found little in first 1m2f run on AW latest; remains with plenty to prove
comments.runjoyrun: AW winner at 1m in early 2024; modest AW and hurdle form for new yard; best watched
comments.sunsetinparis: Five AW wins at about 1m2f but needs to improve on handful of turf starts to have a chance
comments.thepug: Three AW wins at 1m2f/1m3f in 2023; rather up and down over the winter; yard in form

races.raceComment: fightingpoet is marginally preferred with a score of 50.2%, holding clear edges in better suited by conditions over crowdquake. Won 2 of last 6 starts. Ground (Good To Firm) looks ideal with 2 wins from 6 starts in similar conditions, though unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile and regressive form need consideration.

verdict.comment: Although still a maiden DROUTHY NEEBOR could have been found the right race and it looks worth taking a chance on his stamina for 2m.

comments.abstract: Has come up with very little off lowly marks since returning from an absence
comments.adrian: Group 3 winner in Germany; retains ability but returns from another break
comments.chefdetroupe: Two C&D wins among multiple successes; better for recent return over C&D
comments.corsicancaper: Sole AW win in a classified event but 10lb lower than 2m turf win in September; involved
comments.drouthyneebor: Maiden; placed in last five handicaps and tough task over 1m6f latest; Tapeta debut
comments.forglen: Close up in two of four AW handicaps in 2025; ground to make up on Drouthy Neebor
comments.leontrotsky: Promising win on first 2m start at Southwell; good 3rd there latest; solid option
comments.manofriddles: Three 2m wins on AW, including here; mixed since last win and well held over C&D latest
comments.newyorkbay: Won 2nd and 3rd handicaps at 1m6f; stayed 2m when last seen in February 2024; interesting
comments.queenslandboy: 2m turf winner in 2024 but pulled up over hurdles latest and in poor form on AW previously
comments.roidebaviere: In the frame over 1m2f-1m4f in France; has gone walkabout over hurdles and on AW of late
comments.triplenickle: Turf win at 2m in August but AW form is mixed and below best over hurdles of late

races.raceComment: chefdetroupe is marginally preferred with a score of 46.1%. Won 1 of last 6 starts. Going is a significant concern - yet to win on Standard ground from 14 attempts. Could develop into tactical affair with no obvious pace-setter, though unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.

verdict.comment: Ziggy's Triton looks the pick of those with experience, but ROCK IGUANA and Hattal are well-bred newcomers with big price tags.

comments.getreadytorumble: Dropped away to be beaten over 10l on recent Kempton debut (6f); big step forward needed
comments.hattal: 320,000gns sister to French Listed winner; dam a Group-placed winner; likely type on paper
comments.honestcourtesan: Third of six in two AW runs this spring; needs more and she has a wide stall to overcome
comments.lalunita: 300-1 and offered little on her Southwell debut last August (5f)
comments.martyhopkirk: Didn't run as badly as the bare figures suggest on recent Kempton debut (6f)
comments.moneypockets: Showed speed at Southwell 18 days ago but ended up finishing fourth; others look stronger
comments.nachonachonacho: Looked a tricky ride at Kempton last time; debut effort not without hope though
comments.princessvivi: Third foal of a 7f AW winner (RPR 90); stable not known for winning newcomers
comments.rockiguana: 575,000euros yearling; bred to be useful and makes his debut at a modest level
comments.speedofmaajid: Second 2yo run better than his first; gelded since last seen; more to come this year
comments.ziggystriton: Second to useful sort on his sole 2yo start; sets the standard but it's not a daunting one

races.raceComment: honestcourtesan is marginally preferred with a score of 23.3%, holding clear edges in better suited by conditions and superior course form and more progressive over moneypockets. Going is a significant concern - yet to win on Standard ground from 2 attempts. Could develop into tactical affair with no obvious pace-setter. Key attributes include improving, though step up in class and unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.

comments.lexingtonjet: Has struggled in all three runs and has lots to find on this drop back in trip
comments.missyorkshire: Placed in both her runs but she needs improvement to make a big impact back on AW
comments.misterinvincible: His latest third at Ayr puts him firmly in the picture and he's respected on AW debut

comments.yourlove: Went close on recent Chelmsford debut and she should improve for that experience

verdict.comment: This looks wide open but CITY CYCLONE gets the vote ahead of hat-trick seeker Lady Wingalong and last month's C&D winner Novak.

comments.animate: Won at Catterick last June but he's been generally disappointing since; non-runner
comments.chifa: Five-time C&D winner who went close off this mark at Chelmsford latest; in the mix
comments.citycyclone: Triple C&D winner who had a near-miss at Lingfield last time and is only 1lb higher here
comments.harbourvision: 13-time AW winner who went close over C&D on his penultimate run; shortlisted
comments.ladywingalong: Made it 6-17 for David Evans when completing double here latest; respected back up in trip
comments.novak: Recorded his ninth win when scoring over C&D last month; big player again up 3lb
comments.roguesoldier: Dual AW winner but he struggled on stable debut last month and others are preferred
comments.sustained: C&D winner who still has potential and he needs watching in market on his return
comments.swissace: On lengthy losing run but was an eyecatching third at Southwell latest; dangerous
comments.twilightdiamond: Still unexposed and tongue-tie is now added but he needs to raise his game back on AW

races.raceComment: ladywingalong is marginally preferred with a score of 62.7%, holding clear edges in better suited by conditions and stronger recent form and superior course form and more progressive over citycyclone. Won 4 of last 6 starts. Ground (Standard) looks ideal with 5 wins from 11 starts in similar conditions. Could develop into tactical affair with no obvious pace-setter.
